I'll execute the computation to verify the final balance:
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
# Morgan's ledger computation
balance = 49249
print(f"Starting balance: {balance}")

# Add 84718
balance += 84718
print(f"After adding 84718: {balance}")

# Subtract 10095
balance -= 10095
print(f"After subtracting 10095: {balance}")

# Add 77 payments of 50354
payments_total = 77 * 50354
balance += payments_total
print(f"After adding 77 payments of 50354 ({payments_total}): {balance}")

# Subtract 80 refunds of 96898
refunds_total = 80 * 96898
balance -= refunds_total
print(f"After subtracting 80 refunds of 96898 ({refunds_total}): {balance}")

# Add 38 deposits of 93867
deposits_total = 38 * 93867
balance += deposits_total
print(f"After adding 38 deposits of 93867 ({deposits_total}): {balance}")

print(f"\nFinal balance: {balance}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">echo "verified"</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
